limitations: Only nonnegative additive shifts of the binary Thue–Morse sequence and complete LSD-first DFAOs are included.
The stronger-looking MSD-first automaton problem is different and is not resolved.
No claim of independent scientific validation or exhaustive publication-priority certification.
scientific_integrity: The proof is written in full with explicit quantifiers and a minimality argument. The executable checks only cover finite instances. Publication priority is not established by a failed search, and no independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact LSD-first state complexity of translated Thue–Morse sequences
